summary.adaptive: This is a starting point: the goal will fine-tune itself after two weeks of tracking.
summary.floor: To keep you well, your goal never goes below {floor} kcal a day, even if that slows things down a little.
summary.capped: To keep it sustainable and safe, weight loss is limited to about 1% of your weight per week.

family.weightHint: Enter the number of servings and the weight of the whole dish.
family.whoHint: Each person gets the dish to confirm: nothing is added to their journal without their approval.

week.title: My week
week.overspent: This week is already well filled: the remaining days keep a comfortable goal, and everything starts fresh on Monday.
week.largerHint: A family meal or a night out coming up? Tick the day: it gets a bit more, the others a bit less.
week.dailyHint: With a weekly budget you have a total for the week: what you didn't eat one day carries over to the following days, within sensible limits.
week.notLogged: Nothing logged: counted as a day on target

metabolism.title: My metabolism
metabolism.intro: Your starting expenditure is an estimate. From your meals and weigh-ins, the app measures your real expenditure and adjusts your goal every week.
metabolism.measuredDetail: Over the last {days} days, you ate {intake, number} kcal on average and your weight trend changed by {change, number, ::sign-always .00} kg per week.
metabolism.insufficient: Measuring your expenditure takes at least {days} days of tracking. Still missing:
metabolism.missingDays: {count, plural, one {# day of tracking} other {# days of tracking}}
metabolism.missingWeighIns: {count, plural, one {# weigh-in} other {# weigh-ins}} in the period
metabolism.missingLogged: {count, plural, one {# day with logged meals} other {# days with logged meals}}
metabolism.inconsistent: The last few weeks look incomplete (some meals not logged, perhaps): we keep your current goal, and that's perfectly fine.
metabolism.currentEstimate: With your current weight, the formula estimates your expenditure at {value, number} kcal per day.
metabolism.lockedHint: Your goal is locked: the weekly check no longer changes it.
metabolism.unlockedHint: Each week, the goal can move by 150 kcal at most, never below the floor.
metabolism.chart: Estimated expenditure (dashed) and measured expenditure (solid), week by week

status.adjusted: Measured expenditure {measured, number} kcal: goal adjusted from {before, number} to {after, number} kcal.
status.unchanged: Measured expenditure {measured, number} kcal: your goal of {after, number} kcal still fits.
status.locked: Measured expenditure {measured, number} kcal: goal locked at {after, number} kcal.
status.insufficient: Not enough data yet: goal unchanged.

metabolism.how1: Over the last {days} days, we compare what you ate with how your weight trend moved (the smoothed curve, not daily weigh-ins).
metabolism.how2: If your weight goes down more slowly than expected, you spend a little less than the estimate; faster, a little more. Your goal then gently moves towards what works for you.
metabolism.how3: It takes at least 14 days of tracking, 3 weigh-ins and meals logged 8 days out of 10. Adjustments are limited to 150 kcal per week and never go below the calorie floor.
metabolism.disclaimer: {appName} is not medical advice. For any health question, talk to a professional.

quality.title: Quality check
quality.indicative: Indicative markers: 30 g of fibre and 5 portions of fruit and veg (80 g) per day.
quality.empty: Nothing logged in the last 7 days: the check will appear with your first meals.

suggestions.fruitVeg: Add a piece of fruit as a snack or a handful of raw veg at lunch: every portion counts.
suggestions.fiber: A bit more fibre? Think lentils, chickpeas, wholemeal bread or oats.
suggestions.homemade: One more homemade recipe this week, even a simple one, easily replaces a ready meal.
suggestions.salt: Herbs, spices, lemon and garlic add flavour: other ways to season than salt.
suggestions.keepGoing: Great week! Keep it up, and add colour to your plate.

quality.averagesTitle: Daily averages ({days, plural, one {# day logged} other {# days logged}})
quality.averagesHint: Calculated from foods whose values are known.
quality.ultraProcessed: of calories come from ultra-processed foods (NOVA 4), among the {coverage}% whose NOVA group is known.
quality.novaUnknown: The NOVA group is only known for store-bought products scanned or found on Open Food Facts.
quality.sources: Sources: Ciqual (Anses) and Open Food Facts. ANSES, PNNS and WHO markers, for guidance only.

fasting.title: Fasting
fasting.intro: A window to eat, a window to pause. You choose your rhythm day by day, and you can stop whenever you like.
fasting.minor: Intermittent fasting isn't offered under 18. Your body needs regular meals while growing: keep logging your meals as usual.
fasting.disclaimer: Pommelia doesn't give medical advice. If you have diabetes, are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a history of eating disorders or take medication, talk to a health professional before fasting.
